title: Modernize VB6 Forms to C#
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 forms need to be converted to modern C# equivalents.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology increases maintenance costs and security risks.
suggested_approach: Refactor each form into a C# Windows Form application, ensuring UI and business logic are separated.
success_criteria: All forms are functional in C# with equivalent features.
